sentences: The main argument for free museums is that they make culture accessible to everyone.
When entry fees are charged, families on low incomes are often the first to stop visiting.
For example, when several national museums in the UK removed their fees, visitor numbers rose sharply, especially among younger people.
Free entry therefore helps ensure that a country's heritage belongs to all its citizens, not only to those who can afford it.
One clear drawback of working from home is the loss of informal learning.
In an office, junior staff can watch experienced colleagues and ask quick questions.
At home, this kind of learning happens far less, because every question requires a message or a call.
As a result, new employees may take longer to develop the skills they need.
The most effective solution to congestion is better public transport.
If buses and trains are frequent, reliable and affordable, many drivers will choose to leave their cars at home.
Cities such as Vienna, where an annual travel pass costs very little, have seen car use fall significantly.
Investing in public transport therefore reduces traffic while also cutting pollution.
Studying abroad also brings personal benefits.
Living in another country forces students to become more independent, managing money and solving problems on their own.
Many graduates say that this experience gave them confidence that they used throughout their careers.
These personal skills can be just as valuable as academic qualifications.
Parents are right to set some limits on children's screen time.
Long periods in front of a screen can reduce the time children spend on physical activity and sleep.
Research has linked heavy screen use in the evening with shorter and poorer sleep.
Reasonable limits, especially before bedtime, can therefore protect children's health.
Critics argue that taxes on sugary drinks unfairly affect poorer families.
Because these families spend a larger share of their income on food and drink, the extra cost hits them hardest.
However, this concern can be reduced if the money raised is spent on programmes that benefit those same families.
In that case, the tax may help rather than harm them.
A major advantage of online shopping is convenience.
Customers can compare prices and buy goods at any time of day, without travelling.
This is especially valuable for people who live far from shops or have limited mobility.
For many, therefore, online shopping saves both time and money.
Schools can play a key role in protecting endangered languages.
When a language is taught in the classroom, children see that it has value and status.
In Wales, for instance, teaching in Welsh has helped increase the number of young speakers.
Education policy can therefore slow or even reverse the decline of a language.
One reason people are retiring later is that they are living longer and staying healthier.
A sixty-five-year-old today is often fit enough to work for several more years.
At the same time, pensions may not be enough to support a long retirement.
Many people therefore choose, or need, to keep working.
On the other hand, mass tourism can damage the places people come to see.
Popular sites may be overwhelmed by crowds, and housing may be turned into holiday rentals.
In some historic city centres, local residents have been priced out as a result.
Without careful management, tourism can destroy the very character that attracts visitors.
